scripts.package: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const dir = 'cadView'; if (fs.existsSync(dir)) { const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? `Compress-Archive -Path '${dir}/*' -DestinationPath '${dir}.zip' -Force` : `tar -czf ${dir}.tar.gz ${dir}`; console.log('Running:', cmd); execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Package created successfully!'); } else { console.error('Error: cadView directory not found'); process.exit(1); }"
